verdict.rationale: Riveter's docs say its AI agents interpret pages the way a person would, with no brittle selectors, and that enrichments fill new columns using AI and web scrapes. Extraction is driven by a natural-language prompt plus plain attribute names such as "CEO" and "Employee Count", with an API to extract data from complicated websites. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the LLM itself chooses which fields to extract (the examples show user-named attributes), details on output schema and typing, and independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction quality.
